notes: The dative τῇ ἐπαρχείᾳ takes its case preposition *into* on the article under rule 21, no expressed Greek preposition standing to answer to it; rule 106's oblique arm applies because the ASV writes *come* for ἐπιβάς.
ἀνέβη keeps *up* inside its own unit under rule 106, εἰς → *to* carrying no part of it.
